description: Installation works of the Leviathan gas field's production platform being carried out by the Heerema Sleipnir - the world's largest crane vessel as viewed from Ramat HaNadiv (Heights of the Benefactor), a nature park and garden in northern Israel, covering 4.5 km (3 mi) at the southern end of Mount Carmel between Zikhron Ya'akov to the north and Binyamina to the south.
